visual_action: Donald Trump, in a suit and tie, stands in a corridor or aboard a plane, speaking to reporters who are holding microphones towards him. An American flag is visible on a screen in the background.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: He is visually identified by face recognition and is the central speaker throughout the video.

cast.name: unnamed reporter

on_screen_text.text:
Trump on what his MRI looked at:
I have no idea. It wasn't the brain because I took a cognitive test 🤯

spoken_summary: An off-screen reporter asks Donald Trump what part of his body an MRI had examined. Trump replies, "I have no idea," and then adds, "It wasn't the brain because I took a cognitive test and I aced it. I got a perfect mark, which you would be incapable of doing."
audio_music: The audio consists entirely of dialogue from a press scrum, with no music or added sound effects.
editing_pacing: The video is a single, static shot of Donald Trump speaking. The main editing element is the addition of large, yellow, word-by-word subtitles that emphasize his speech.
central_claim: Donald Trump makes a confusing and boastful statement suggesting a cognitive test result somehow proves an MRI was not performed on his brain.
intended_effect: To portray Donald Trump as absurd and unfit for office, encouraging mockery from the audience.
